# `company.principals`

Company-local identity copies for rendering provenance without the hub database.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Hub user id represented by this local identity copy. |
| `username` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | Username copied from the hub for local provenance rendering. |
| `display_name` | VARCHAR(128) | no | — | — | — | — | Display name copied from the hub for local provenance rendering. |
| `kind` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | Actor kind copied from the hub: human, agent, or system. |
| `first_seen_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when this identity first appeared in the company. |
| `last_seen_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when this identity most recently appeared in the company. |
